name: Ashra
full_name: All-sky Survey High Resolution Air-shower detector
summary: An optical air-shower programme in Hawaii developed wide-field, high-resolution imaging and carried out early Earth-skimming tau-neutrino searches.
detection_principle: Specialised wide-field optics and an electrostatic image pipeline detect fast atmospheric Cherenkov and fluorescence signals. A mountain provides a neutrino target for tau-emergence searches.

status.label: Completed / historical
status.evidence: Historical Ashra-1 operation and published search are documented; continuous present-day operation is not inferred from the old detector-design page.

collaboration.name: Ashra Collaboration
collaboration.participants_note: Institutions listed here are selected documented participants; the official collaboration page provides the complete membership.

key_parameters.name: Technique
key_parameters.value: Combined high-resolution optical imaging and fast shower triggering

results.summary: An early observational limit was placed on PeV–EeV tau-neutrino emission associated with GRB081203A; no neutrino signal was established.

science_scope: Parameters refer to the named apparatus or explicitly identified design phase. Projections describe sensitivity goals and are not observations.
